practice_units.title: The Bhakti Movement
practice_units.problem: Identify the key teachings of Bhakti saints like Kabir or Mirabai.
guidance: They emphasized personal devotion (bhakti) to God over complex rituals.
Many saints preached in the local languages of the people.
They often rejected social differences like caste.
practice_units.solution: Key teachings include: 1. Oneness of God. 2. Path of love and devotion. 3. Rejection of rituals and social inequalities.
